acquisition method: A top-five method was used to select up to the five most abundant precursor ions with a charge ≥2.
alkylation reagent: alkylated with 55 mM iodoacetamide for an additional 30 min.
alkylation concentration: alkylated with 55 mM iodoacetamide for an additional 30 min.
cleavage agent: digested with 1 μg of LysC for 3 h at room temperature. After adding four volumes of 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate, 1 μg trypsin was added
collision energy: normalized collision energy of 25 (27 for Q Exactive HF)
Selected precursor ions were subjected to high-energy collisional dissociation fragmentation at a normalized collision energy of 25 (27 for Q Exactive HF)
fractionation method: This remarkable depth, considering the absence of any fractionation step, was accompanied by a median protein sequence coverage of 43.6%
fragmentation method: Selected precursor ions were subjected to high-energy collisional dissociation fragmentation
instrument: Q Exactive and Q Exactive HF

ionization type: coupled to an EASY-nLC 1000 HPLC system (Thermo Fisher Scientific) via a nano electrospray source.
labeling: Label-free protein quantification (LFQ) using the MaxLFQ algorithm resulted in a median depth of 7,828 protein quantifications per single measurement.
reduction reagent: Proteins in the lysate were reduced with 10 mM DTT for 30 min
reduction concentration: Proteins in the lysate were reduced with 10 mM DTT for 30 min
